metrics.limitation: Retrospective event-level evaluation using receipt timestamps; not production accuracy or measured live processing latency.

protocol: Fixed rules and parameters; separate earlier reference window; services, identities, roles and action names renamed by seed. Labels are passed only to score(). Synthetic, not real-world accuracy.
tradeoff: Actor-wide fan-out and two-hop sensitivity connect benign novelty and isolated denials in this original, unchanged holdout. Reported false positives are retained; recall is not evidence of identifying stolen credentials in isolation.
